review:
The Coins formula on 16 separate reels, with the Grand Jackpot raised to 5,000x, the top of the series. Cash Infinity symbols stay on the reels until the end of the next bonus, adding value and making Hold the Jackpot easier to trigger.

In the bonus you get three respins that reset with each new symbol, and filling the grid can award the Grand. Cash Out labels count down, collect Bonus values and pay out, multiplied by up to 300%. High volatility, 96.17% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
